summary: Verify vendor payee name vs bank metadata before scheduled payout (NordPoint Shipping GmbH)
description: Issue summary: A scheduled payout for vendor 'NordPoint Shipping GmbH' was flagged by the bank on payout day due to a payee name mismatch and IBAN formatting concerns. Treasury put the transaction on hold to avoid rejection. Impact: vendor payment delayed, potential late-fee exposure and vendor escalation to Partnerships. This ticket coordinates AP, Treasury, and Vendor Ops to validate identity and release the payment.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Vendor submitted invoice INV-2026-334 via vendor portal on 2026-03-05 with payee 'NordPoint Shipping' (no legal suffix).
2) AP approved invoice and created a scheduled payrun for 2026-03-12 through NetSuite/Payments service.

3) Treasury submitted ACH/SEPA instruction to bank for execution; bank returned a reject/hold citing 'payee name does not match beneficiary records' and flagged IBAN formatting (extra non-ASCII characters).
4) Treasury placed payrun on hold, notified AP and Vendor Ops; vendor opened an escalation thread in #vendor-ops on Slack.
observed_logs: Bank response (2026-03-12T08:14:22Z): STATUS=HOLD; REASON='BEN_NAME_MISMATCH'; DETAILS='Payee name differs from account holder record; verify spelling and legal entity suffix.'
Payments service audit (net-svc-2026-03-12.log): payout_id=PR-77821; bank_status=HOLD; attempt=1
Vendor portal submission metadata: vendor_profile_id=VND-9082; payee_display='NordPoint Shipping'; attached_business_registry='Hand-signed PDF, company name: NordPoint Shipping GmbH'
investigation_notes: Finance/Payments review (Markus): Vendor profile payee_display lacks legal suffix 'GmbH' while registry doc includes it. NetSuite vendor record payee_name='NordPoint Shipping' (legacy entry from 2024 onboarding).

Treasury checked the SWIFT/IBAN lookup: IBAN provided 'DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00' contains a non-standard invisible character when copy-pasted from the PDF (U+200B). Bank parser flagged formatting and normalized copy failed.

Vendor Ops reached out to vendor 2026-03-12 09:20 and received corrected supplier bank confirmation PDF with explicit legal name 'NordPoint Shipping GmbH' and signed bank statement (received 2026-03-12 11:05).
Risk assessment: If released without name alignment, bank may reject leading to chargebacks and manual correction windows; keeping on hold is recommended until name/IBAN are confirmed.
comments: Aisha Khan (Finance Ops) 2026-03-12 09:35: Put on hold after bank reject. Notified Vendor Ops and Partnerships. Asked vendor for KYC doc and bank statement.
Vendor Ops (Lena Morales) 2026-03-12 11:12: Vendor provided signed bank confirmation and clarified legal entity is 'NordPoint Shipping GmbH'. Requested AP update vendor record and re-run payrun.
Treasury (Ravi Patel) 2026-03-12 12:04: Found invisible char in IBAN when copied from PDF. Cleaned IBAN and validated checksum; bank advises to resubmit with exact legal entity name.

Markus Lee (Assignee) 2026-03-13 08:50: Updated NetSuite vendor record payee_name -> 'NordPoint Shipping GmbH' and vendor_profile metadata. Prepared manual SEPA resubmission; scheduled for 2026-03-13T14:00 UTC pending final sign-off.
Lena Morales 2026-03-13 09:20: Confirmed vendor acceptance of manual payout and waiver of any expedited fee. Asked to include legal entity suffix in portal UI placeholder.
resolution: Workaround/fix: Manually verified vendor KYC and corrected NetSuite vendor record payee_name to 'NordPoint Shipping GmbH'. Cleaned IBAN string to remove non-printable characters and validated checksum. Treasury re-submitted SEPA instruction on 2026-03-13T14:05 UTC; bank accepted and cleared on 2026-03-13T17:22 UTC. Vendor confirmed receipt 2026-03-13 18:03 CET. Payments pipeline updated with a one-time patch to sanitize IBANs during import.
follow_up_tasks: Create a vendor onboarding validation rule to require legal entity suffix and example formatting in portal (owner: Vendor Ops, due: 2026-03-25)
Add IBAN/ACH sanitization step in payments ingestion microservice to strip invisible characters and normalize whitespace (owner: Payments eng, PR: GH-2311)

Implement a pre-flight payrun validator that flags payees whose registered legal name differs from submitted bank beneficiary name and surface to AP for manual verification (owner: AP product, due: 2026-04-05)
Add alert to operations dashboard to flag 'payrun holds' with high frequency over a 24-hour window (owner: SRE/Observability, runbook link added below)
Update vendor onboarding runbook and vendor portal copy to request exact bank account holder name as it appears on bank records (owner: Vendor Ops)
